title: LQ-Rec: Late Quantization for Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) for sequential recommendation compresses each item into a short semantic ID and trains an autoregressive decoder to generate next-item codes from a user history. While appealing for cold-start handling and storage, au- toregressive GR suffers a structural scaling limit: typically, longer semantic IDs reduce quantization error in principle but degrade ranking quality and quadratic memory usage against semantic ID length. We propose Late Quantization (LQ), a non-autoregressive paradigm that confines discretization to the output (item) side of the pipeline. The encoder and scoring rule operate in continuous space, while items are stored and matched as semantic IDs produced by an end-to-end-trained residual quantizer. This architectural shift permits an additive error decomposition and a pairwise ordering theorem that jointly bound the quantization- induced ranking drop, a structural guarantee absent in prior semant

translated_title: LQ-Rec：面向序列推荐的后期量化
translated_abstract: 面向序列推荐的生成式检索（GR）将每个物品压缩为一个简短的语义ID，并训练自回归解码器根据用户历史生成下一物品的编码。尽管自回归GR在冷启动处理和存储方面颇具吸引力，但它存在结构性的扩展限制：通常，更长的语义ID虽然在原则上可以减少量化误差，却会降低排序质量，且内存占用随语义ID长度呈二次增长。我们提出了后期量化，这是一种非自回归范式，它将离散化限制在流程的输出（物品）端。编码器和评分规则在连续空间中运行，而物品则以语义ID的形式进行存储和匹配，这些语义ID由端到端训练的残差量化器生成。这种架构转变使得加性误差分解与成对排序定理成为可能，二者共同界定了由量化引起的排序下降，这是以往语义ID方法所缺乏的结构性保证。
tldr: 该论文提出“后期量化”这一非自回归范式，将序列推荐中生成式检索的离散化限制在物品输出端，从而突破自回归语义ID的结构性扩展限制，并通过加性误差分解与成对排序定理为量化引起的排序损失提供了以往方法所不具备的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Late Quantization, a non-autoregressive paradigm that confines discretization to the item-output side of sequential recommendation, overcoming the structural scaling limits of autoregressive generative retrieval while providing an additive error decomposition and a pairwise ordering theorem that bound quantization-induced ranking degradation.
